email.subject: Quick fix for Velvet Hair Studio's site
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I looked at Velvet Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there are no reviews shown anywhere on the site, so new visitors can't see that other clients trust you before they call. And the photos are large unoptimized files, which slows the page down on phones — a lot of people searching for a salon on their phone will just leave before it loads.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee, no ongoing contract. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd fix and why? No obligation either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
